newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Group unions on partial strikes.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Group unions on partial strikes.

text.p: Unions at companies affiliated with South Korea's Hyundai Group changed gears to partial strikes from full-out stoppages on Thursday, an official at the Hyundai Group Trade Union Federation said.
Thirteen of the federation's 22 unions remained on partial strike, including Hyundai Motor Co Ltd, Hyundai Heavy Industries Co Ltd, and Hyundai Precision and Industries Co, the official said.
A total of sixteen Hyundai Group unions had joined the work stoppage after the ruling party rammed a controversial labour law through parliament on December 26.
The official said the unions were easing their strike plans in accordance with a call by the militant Korean Confederation of Trade Unions.
The confederation has asked that companies in the manufacturing sector return to work fully or partially before a full strike scheduled for next Wednesday.
